task.title: Page claimed recurrence occurrences through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/945 to expose bounded current-claim paging through a read-only deterministic adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity and page size before opening existing storage read-only.
Delegate lifecycle filtering and cursor semantics and emit exact claim JSON.
Preserve stable diagnostics, no stdout on failure, and corruption isolation.

attempts.diagnostic: CLI integration tests failed because claimed was not a recognized recurrence subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the issue contract before completing the production boundary.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented read-only validation and delegation, shared claimed projection serialization, diagnostics, tests, and ADR-0075.
attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 945 contract in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blockers and CodeRabbit posted no actionable inline findings; a heuristic docstring percentage did not identify a behavioral defect.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 945 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 946 exact head

lessons: Adapters should share output projection without duplicating kernel lifecycle policy.
Validation before storage prevents accidental database creation.
Inspection grants no mutation, clock, global discovery, workers, permissions, or execution.
